The screen sizes of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will remain the same as the previous generation, but there are rumors that their displays will be upgraded in two other areas. Below are the upcoming new features.

#1: LTPO+ Technology

LTPO is the technology that has always supported the iPhone's "Always-On Display" and ProMotion features. On the iPhone 18 Pro, there are reports that Apple will upgrade to a more advanced LTPO+.

The benefits of LTPO+ include reducing screen flickering in dim environments (because it can adjust more flexibly), while improving power-saving efficiency. Therefore, iPhone 18 Pro users should be able to enjoy a more stable display performance with better battery life.

#2: Smaller "Dynamic Island" Cutout

The displays of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are also expected to feature a smaller "Dynamic Island" cutout. As a result, the available screen space will increase slightly.

There are reports that the new "Dynamic Island" will be approximately 35% smaller than what is offered on the iPhone 17 Pro. This size has actually been hinted at in iOS 27, within the new design of Siri.

Apple first introduced the "Dynamic Island" on the iPhone 14 Pro in 2022. Although the software features related to "Dynamic Island" and "Live Activities" have continued to expand over the years, the physical cutout has remained unchanged.

With the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple is finally getting closer to realizing the dream of a "zero-cutout" display.

What other changes would you like to see in future iPhone displays? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
